title: At candle lighting, Aquino grandson urges Filipinos to remember Martial Law

blocks.text: Kiko Aquino-Dee, grandson of the late President Corazon Aquino and democracy icon Benigno “Ninoy” Aquino Jr., renewed calls to remember the abuses of Martial Law and the sacrifices of those who fought to restore democracy as the Philippines marked its 54th anniversary on Monday, September 21, 2026.
